items.title: 万亿估值前夜，OpenAI 被曝一年亏约 2600 亿
items.raw_excerpt: 据 Ed Zitron 披露、并由《金融时报》独立核实的审计财务文件，OpenAI 2025 年归属于公司的净亏损达到 385.3 亿美元（约合人民币 2600 亿元），较 2024 年的 50.9 亿美元扩大约 7.6 倍。

title_i18n.zh: 万亿估值前夜，OpenAI 被曝一年亏约 2600 亿
title_i18n.en: On the eve of a trillion-dollar valuation, OpenAI is reported to have lost approximately 260 billion yuan in one year.
title_i18n.es: En la antesala de una valoración de billones, se revela que OpenAI pierde aproximadamente 260 mil millones al año.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 据 Ed Zitron 披露、并由《金融时报》独立核实的审计财务文件，OpenAI 2025 年归属于公司的净亏损达到 385.3 亿美元（约合人民币 2600 亿元），较 2024 年的 50.9 亿美元扩大约 7.6 倍。
excerpt_i18n.en: According to audited financial documents disclosed by Ed Zitron and independently verified by the Financial Times, OpenAI's net loss attributable to the company in 2025 reached $38.53 billion (approximately RMB 260 billion), expanding about 7.6 times from $5.09 billion in 2024.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según los documentos financieros auditados revelados por Ed Zitron y verificados de forma independiente por el Financial Times, la pérdida neta atribuible a OpenAI en 2025 alcanzó los 38.530 millones de dólares (aproximadamente 260.000 millones de yuanes), lo que supone un aumento de aproximadamente 7,6 veces respecto a los 5.090 millones de dólares de 2024.

Cerebras is using wafer-scale processing to take that idea even further, with each wafer providing 44GB of SRAM. d-Matrix is leveraging processing-in-memory to improve performance

items.title: A framework for verifiable analysis of AI behavior
items.raw_excerpt: Developing an AI agent is a complex data analysis problem. To know if the agent is working correctly, we need to track not just benchmark scores but the details of its behavior: how do the strategies change over the course of training? Why does the new scaffold perform worse? Is there reward hacking? Answering these questions requires a combination of quantitative and qualitative analysis tailored to the dataset at hand.

title_i18n.en: A framework for verifiable analysis of AI behavior
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能行为可验证分析框架
title_i18n.es: Un marco para el análisis verificable del comportamiento de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Developing an AI agent is a complex data analysis problem. To know if the agent is working correctly, we need to track not just benchmark scores but the details of its behavior: how do the strategies change over the course of training? Why does the new scaffold perform worse? Is there reward hacking? Answering these questions requires a combination of quantitative and qualitative analysis tailored to the dataset at hand.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 开发AI智能体是一个复杂的数据分析问题。要判断智能体是否正常运行，我们不仅需要追踪基准测试分数，还需关注其行为细节：策略在过程中如何变化。
excerpt_i18n.es: Desarrollar un agente de IA es un problema complejo de análisis de datos. Para saber si el agente funciona correctamente, no solo debemos rastrear las puntuaciones de referencia, sino también los detalles de su comportamiento: ¿cómo cambian las estrategias a lo largo del proceso?

items.title: Tablething – local-first database client with BYOK AI
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, Tablething is a cross-platform, local-first database client built with Tauri. It currently connects to 13 data sources including Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, ElasticSearch, with more on the way. Everything runs locally - nothing is sent to our servers. There are optional AI features that you can use with your own API key and data is directly sent to the provider. I built it because I wanted a tool to save my queries, visualize the data from different sources and have agentic chat the way I wanted. It's free, and I plan to open-source the core once it's stable. Would love any feedback: https://tablething.com

items.title: The AI Privacy Problem Isn't What You Tell AI – It's What AI Infers
items.raw_excerpt: The core AI privacy issue is not what users voluntarily share, but what AI infers from data, potentially exposing sensitive attributes like health or political views.

title_i18n.en: The AI Privacy Problem Isn't What You Tell AI – It's What AI Infers

items.title: Context intelligence for your data and AI agents at scale
items.raw_excerpt: Agents are only as intelligent as the context they can reason over. Today, that context is scattered across data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, databases, and streams, and in institutional knowledge that has never been written down. You want to trust the decisions made by your AI agents, but that can't happen until agents have context. Imagine what becomes possible when we give agents a safe way to access the context they need to deliver trusted decisions. This is why at the AWS Summit New York City, we’re announcing a series of innovations that deliver intelligence for your data and AI agents at scale.
